errors.text: The proposed alloy and processing route differ fundamentally from the target: NbMoTaWVTi hot extrusion is substituted for printed equiatomic HfNbTaTiZr hydride ink followed by hydrogen de-binding and vacuum sintering.
The required thermal history is not reconstructed: the hypothesis omits 1400 °C sintering for 18 hours, the titanium-sponge oxygen getter, and water quenching from 1500 °C.

It treats approximately 1 wt.% oxygen as contamination to eliminate, whereas the target deliberately retains approximately 1 wt.% oxygen for interstitial strengthening while suppressing alpha-HCP formation through rapid quenching.

The asserted coherent B2/L21 nanoprecipitates have no direct evidentiary basis in the proposed NbMoTaWVTi hydride system and replace the target's metastable single beta-BCC phase without justification.
The hypothesis omits the sequential Ta-to-Nb-to-Hf/Ti/Zr hydride decomposition mechanism governed by hydride formation enthalpies.
The cited evidence does not support the specified ramp, 700 °C hold, in-die decomposition, hot-extrusion conditions, or claimed mechanical-property thresholds.
